title: Stripe Billing Invoice Weekly Payment Lag Trend
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stripe:invoice payment_latency_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(payment_latency_minutes) as avg_duration, max(payment_latency_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst payment lag for Stripe Billing invoice events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture payment_latency_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average payment lag with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether Stripe Billing invoice tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
